title: Life Is Strangeous
description: This mod is inspired by Life Is Strange. There is 25 Discs, 6 paintings and lighthouses. The discs can be obtained by recipe, drop and trades.
body:
> Within this world, there are 25 collectible discs and 6 paintings, each carefully designed to reflect the mood and themes of the game. The discs feature a wide variety of music tracks, ranging from indie melodies to emotional soundscapes, providing an auditory journey that complements the visual and narrative aspects of the mod. Each track tells a story, evokes memories, or enhances the atmosphere, just like the iconic soundtrack of Life Is Strange.


# **Players can obtain the discs in several ways:**


**By recipe:** combining resources or items within the game to craft a specific disc.

**By drop:** Killing entites.

**By trade:** exchanging with NPCs or other players, encouraging interaction and strategic decision-making.

**By loot:** discover chests.

The paintings, on the other hand, serve as a visual collection, each piece carefully chosen to resonate with the themes of nostalgia, emotion, and personal growth. Together, the discs and paintings create a multidimensional experience, blending music, art, and story into a cohesive and immersive world for the player to explore and enjoy.

## SPOILER 1 —  HINTS ONLY

Youth – Daughter: Kill monster.

No Below – Speedy Ortiz: Kill monster.

The Right Way Around – Daughter: Something crafted from what once lived but no longer does.

All I Wanted – Daughter: Defeat a creature of the deepest darkness.

Spanish Sahara – Foals: Seek fire-forged materials born from the hottest lands.

Washington – Local Natives: Defeat a being of pure destruction.

Something Good – alt-J: Challenge a summoner of fangs and illusions.

To All Of You – Syd Matters: Only those between life and undeath carry it.

Obstacles – Syd Matters: Trade with those who handle sacred items.

Taking You There – Broods:Trade with those who handle sacred items.

Crosses – José González: Trade with those who handle sacred items.

Burning the Midnight Oil – Daughter: Talk to a master of metalwork.

Glass – Daughter: Crafted where metal and fragility meet.

Santa Monica Dream – Angus & Julia Stone: Hidden beneath the ancient ocean.

Burn It Down – Daughter: Something that thrives in lava must fall.

A Hole in the Earth – Daughter: Defeat a creature near a hole

Bros – Wolf Alice: A gentle creature may drop it.

Witches – Daughter: Defeat a wielder of potions.

Max & Chloe – Jonathan Morali: Found in a special place shaped by memory.

Lanterns on the Lake – Lanterns on the Lake: Found where light is preserved.

Mountains – Message to Bears: A snow-born creature carries it.

## SPOILER 2 SOLUTIONS + REASONS

Youth – Daughter: 1/1000 chance by killing spiders — Reason: Difficulty.

No Below – Speedy Ortiz: 1/1000 chance by killing spiders — Reason: Difficulty.

The Right Way Around – Daughter: Craftable with dead coral blocks, pumpkin and mushroom — Reason: Symbolism of nature dying / Rachel’s burnt forest.

All I Wanted – Daughter: 1/5 chance by killing a Warden — Reason: Difficulty.

Spanish Sahara – Foals: Discoverable recipe requiring Netherite-tier materials — Reason: Sand and desert symbolism.

Washington – Local Natives: 1/2 chance by killing the Wither — Reason: Difficulty.

Something Good – alt-J: 1/10 chance by killing an Evoker — Reason: Difficulty.

To All Of You – Syd Matters: 1/2 chance by killing a Zombie Villager — Reason: Difficulty.

Obstacles – Syd Matters: Trade with a Cleric using blue flower + clock — Reason: Symbolic link with time and difficulty.

Taking You There – Broods: Apprentice Cleric trade (blue candle + trident) — Reason: Symbolism + difficulty through rare items.

Crosses – José González: Apprentice Cleric trade (Shroomlight + Tropical Fish Bucket) — Reason: Symbolism + aquatic/glowing difficulty.

Burning the Midnight Oil – Daughter: Trade with an Armorer — Reason: Link with metalworking and the theme of labor.

Glass – Daughter: Trade with an Armorer — Reason: Fragility and crafting symbolism.

Santa Monica Dream – Angus & Julia Stone: 1/2 chance by killing an Elder Guardian — Reason: Ocean + nostalgia theme.

Burn It Down – Daughter: 1/5 chance by killing a Magma Cube — Reason: Fire/lava thematic link.

A Hole in the Earth – Daughter: 1/2 chance by killing silverfish — Reason: Thematic link to depth and burial.

Bros – Wolf Alice: Dropped by killing a Wolf — Reason: Title link (“Bros” → wolves / companionship).

Witches – Daughter: 1/5 chance by killing a Witch — Reason: Direct thematic link.

Max & Chloe – Jonathan Morali: Found in a chest inside a special mod structure — Reason: Memory and narrative connection.

Lanterns on the Lake – Lanterns on the Lake: Chest inside a special mod structure — Reason: Light, quietness, and atmosphere.

Mountains – Message to Bears: Dropped by killing a Snow Golem — Reason: Snow/mountain thematic link.

Blackwell Academy – Jonathan Morali: Trade with a Librarian — Reason: School/knowledge symbolism.

Piano Fire – Sparklehorse: Recipe with crying obsidian, soul campfire, firefly bush — Reason: Fire + soul + music symbolism.

Numbers – Daughter: Recipe with clock, bottle o’ experience, recovery compass — Reason: Time and memory symbolism.

No Care – Daughter: Very hard recipe using End Crystal, Totem of Undying or Elytra — Reason: High difficulty.
